collection.title: BMW 2 Series Active Tourer 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The BMW 2 Series Active Tourer 2021 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" the passengers side, all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment.
